title: SystemResponse
description:
Evaluation response payload containing answers to all submitted questions.

See <https://docs.typesafe.ai/api#response-body> for the canonical wire specification.

model.description: The model backend that performed the evaluation. **Required.**

Answer.description: Tagged union of answer models matching the evaluated question types.

oneOf.description: Boolean probability answer containing a single probability value.
Categorical choice answer containing selected label, probability distribution, and confidence.
Ordinal rating answer containing the evaluated score, rubric legend, probabilities, and confidence.

ChoiceAnswer.description:
`probabilities` is a full distribution (sums to 1) over the criteria keys.
`confidence` is required (per spec). `f64` for wire-format precision.

choice.description: Selected option identifier matching one of the keys in question criteria.

confidence.description: Model confidence score in `[0.0, 1.0]` derived from the probability distribution.

probabilities.description: Normalized probability distribution over all criteria options summing to 1.0.

NoulAnswer.description:
Spec: `noul` is a number 0..1. **No `confidence` field** — Noul answers
don't get one per the spec.

`f64` so wire-format precision matches the API spec exactly (a 0.92
going through f32 round-trips to 0.9200000166893005 — wrong).

noul.description: Probability value in `[0.0, 1.0]` representing the likelihood that the answer is true/yes.

ScoreAnswer.description:
`legend` is level-index (string) → level description.
`probabilities` is keyed by the same index strings. `confidence` required.
`f64` for wire-format precision.

confidence.description: Model confidence score in `[0.0, 1.0]` derived from the probability distribution.

legend.description: Mapping of numeric level index strings (`"0"`, `"1"`, ...) to rubric descriptions.

probabilities.description: Normalized probability distribution over the level indices summing to 1.0.

score.description: Inferred expected score value along the ordinal rubric.

Usage.description:
Token usage accounting for the evaluation request.

**Required** per the Jev wire specification.

input_tokens.description: Number of tokens in the input state and question instructions.

output_tokens.description: Number of tokens accounted to generating the evaluated judgments.
